England inflicts record T20I defeat on India by 125 runs

England defeated India by 125 runs in the third T20I, marking India's largest defeat in the format by margin of runs. The Indian batting lineup collapsed, with only a few players scoring in double digits. This loss puts India in a 2-0 series deficit against England. Coach Gautam Gambhir attributed the struggles to a team 'reset' and the need to integrate young players.
